description: Lists owner-scoped artifact runs for one live/scheduled deployment, or for up to 10 related deployments via deploymentIds. Every returned row includes deploymentId so run IDs remain paired with the deployment that owns them. Use this when the user asks what evidence is available for a deployment, or before inspecting why an agent bought, sold, or did nothing. When reporting event times, retain the returned timestamp and its time zone. Quoting the original UTC timestamp is valid; convert to a local zone only with its correct date-specific offset, and never apply an offset twice. This reads only manifest.json files in the deployment's artifact namespace; it does not read arbitrary S3 keys.
name: list_deployment_runs
title: List deployment artifact runs
